en.headline: Police investigate Peak house burglary after four Hermès handbags reported stolen
en.dek: Officers classified the case as burglary after a domestic helper reported a pried-open window at a detached house on Mount Austin Road on Thursday.
body: Police are investigating a burglary at a detached house on Mount Austin Road on Victoria Peak after four Hermès handbags valued at about HK$150,000 were reported stolen on Thursday afternoon.
Officers were called to the property at around 5 p.m. after a domestic helper reported a suspected break-in. Responding officers found that a window in one of the rooms had been pried open.
Police classified the case as burglary and assigned it to the Central district crime investigation team. No arrests have been made so far.
The investigation is continuing as officers work to identify the person or persons responsible and recover the missing items.

zh.headline: 山頂獨立屋遭爆竊 失約15萬元Hermès手袋
zh.dek: 外傭周四下午報案指柯士甸山道獨立屋有窗戶被撓，警方列作爆竊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方正調查港島山頂柯士甸山道一幢獨立屋的爆竊案，周四下午有外傭報稱四個價值約15萬元的Hermès手袋失竊。
警方於下午約5時接報到場，發現屋內一間房間的窗戶被撓開。
案件列作爆竊，交由中區警區刑事調查隊跟進。目前暫未有人被捕。
調查仍在進行，警方正追查涉案人士並嘗試尋回失物。
